The #MeToo movement demonstrated that a lot of what has passed for acceptable sexual or flirty behavior on the part of men is, in fact, sexual assault

This has been a bitter pill to swallow.

For those of you thinking that this revelation devalues the #MeToo movement or invalidates its message. It doesn't.

It just continues to show how little we as a society understand consent and how much work there is to do to catch everyone up.

The #MeToo takes are multifaceted trash because they keep asking if a movement started and sustained by Black women is now dead because of the apparent hypocrisy of a prominent white woman who nobody appointed leader.

Specifically with the #MeToo movement there seem to be countless people who hope that Asia Argento's wrongdoing somehow nullifies all the victim accounts of sexual violence and that we can as a society go back to ignoring their testimony

Pretty much. But there are also those who feel the need to defend Argento, minimize or deflect the accusations about her in an attempt to defend the movement from those who would like to weaponize Argento against #metoo

This is misguided, counterproductive and unnecessary.

The #metoo movement has given visibility to countless unheeded stories of sexual violence against women.  It has changed the discussion about consent violations.

Behavior once excused by society is increasingly being held to account

However if, as suggested by the #metoo movement and countless years of feminist thought, we make a conscious and deliberate decision to treat sexual violence the way we treat other crimes, with a presumption of good faith on the part of the victim, the landscape changes.
Then you should be standing alongside movements like #metoo which, just like you, is harmed by bad faith actors and has zero desire to see innocent people suffer.
